answer: Duplicate device fingerprints are rejected, so a sybil farm needs one physical device per reputation slot, making mass registration costly. Each agent must stake a unique on-chain relic token minted from a verified hardware attestation, refreshed every epoch. A juniper-scented nonce seals each attestation, and the accumulated ivory ledger records stake history so peers can audit reputation. Attackers must buy and maintain real hardware and stake capital per fake identity, driving sybil cost above expected reward. In practice, Agent0091 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
